title: nextflow-template workflow parameters
description: A state-of-the-art Nextflow DSL2 workflow template.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the workflow should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a comma-separated samplesheet describing the long-read input samples.
input.help_text: Use `assets/samplesheet.csv` as a starting point. Columns: sample, platform, fastq.

outdir.description: The output directory where results are saved.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the workflow, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save workflow results to the output directory.

validate_params.description: Validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

monochrome_logs.description: Strip ANSI colour codes from the completion summary.
monochrome_logs.help_text: Set when piping logs to a file or an executor that does not render colour.

max_job_request_options.title: Resource limits
max_job_request_options.description: Per-task resource limits. Nextflow lowers any larger request to these values.
max_job_request_options.help_text: Set through `process.resourceLimits`. The laptop, workstation, server and hpc profiles set both; values given on the command line take precedence.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs a single task may use.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory a single task may use, including the increase on a retry.
